section_summary.extract_value: This section provides a theoretical discussion of body appreciation across sexual orientation, focusing on sexual minority men. It explains that sexual minority men tend to experience more negative body image than heterosexual men, and applies the sociocultural model to understand this difference, proposing that appearance-potent subcultures, increased appearance pressures, and social comparison tendencies contribute to lower body appreciation in sexual minority men. No empirical studies or data are presented in this section.
